tender.title: Framework for Traffic Management for NGED and NGET
tender.description:
To provide full Traffic Management, Traffic Control, and the hire of Traffic Light systems.
The Contractor must adhere to and fully comply with the following:
•	New Roads and Street Works Act 1991
•	Traffic Management Act 2004
•	Traffic Signs Manual Chapter 8
•	Safety at Street Works and Road Works Code of Practice (COP) as amended
•	Permit schemes (especially conditions relating to traffic management)
•	Highway Authority and Utilities Committee (HAUC) Advice Notes as applicable
•	ARTSM (Association for Road Traffic Safety and Management) Edition 1.1
The Contractor must be able to support all specified geographical areas of National Grid UK with sufficient resources to provide Plant, Product and Design & Services to enable safe working for all road traffic scenarios. 
The Contractor must provide a 24-hour 365-day service, with the ability to respond and be on-site within 2 hours of  receipt of notification from NGED / NGET.

lots.title: Lot 1 / Area 1 Wales and North West of England
lots.description:
Wales and North West of England - Traffic Management Services as described in the Specification. 
To provide full Traffic Management, Traffic Control, and the hire of Traffic Light systems.
The Contractor must adhere to and fully comply with the following:
•	New Roads and Street Works Act 1991
•	Traffic Management Act 2004
•	Traffic Signs Manual Chapter 8
•	Safety at Street Works and Road Works Code of Practice (COP) as amended
•	Permit schemes (especially conditions relating to traffic management)
•	Highway Authority and Utilities Committee (HAUC) Advice Notes as applicable
•	ARTSM (Association for Road Traffic Safety and Management) Edition 1.1
The Contractor must be able to support all specified geographical areas of National Grid UK with sufficient resources to provide Plant, Product and Design & Services to enable safe working for all road traffic scenarios. 
The Contractor must provide a 24-hour 365-day service, with the ability to respond and be on-site within 2 hours of  receipt of notification from NGED / NGET.
All Staff should be legally qualified to support Street Works legislation.
The rates are to include complying with the 'Traffic Management Act 2004' and all associated secondary legislation and codes of practice, and are deemed to include for supply, delivery, installation, and collection of all apparatus.
